overview_description.description: Sully.ai is printing labor for health systems by building a team of autonomous AI agents to run the entire hospital operations. The autonomous agents run like ClawdBot in the background (Receptionists, Medical Consultant, Triage Nurse, Scribes, Coders) collaborate to execute entire workflows—replacing the $800B labor doing all the manual work at hospitals.

product.name: AI Agentic Teams for Clinical Operations
product.description: AI-powered teams that automate medical tasks across the entire patient journey, integrating with electronic health records and healthcare workflows.

product.name: AI Scribe Agent
product.description: An AI agent that generates clinical notes from conversations during patient visits, automating medical documentation.

product.name: AI Receptionist Agent
product.description: An AI agent that manages patient appointments and front desk operations, including scheduling and communication.

product.name: AI Nurse Agent
product.description: An AI agent that coordinates patient care activities by automating routine nursing tasks and supporting clinical workflows.

product.name: AI Medical Consultant Agent
product.description: An AI agent that assists healthcare providers with clinical procedures and decision support during patient care.

product.name: AI Medical Interpreter Agent
product.description: An AI agent that provides rapid translation services in over 20 languages to support communication between patients and healthcare providers.
